step: N19.2g record-matching contrastive margin (loss only, +0 parameters)
purpose: test whether the saturated record margin, not the ordered encoding, swallows the swap signal found in 19.2f

design.decoy: hardest same-world same-kind non-gold record (3 candidates per start)
design.aggregation: max over the two content starts (worst case)
design.span_head: inherited 258-parameter head, still trained by the selection stage as in 19.2c
design.formal_eval: 192 examples, exact 27-byte action + EOS, free decode

train_margin_activity.meaning: 0 active points means max(0, m - (score_gold - score_decoy)) is identically zero on the training split, so the added term carries no gradient there

aggregation_ablation.reading: mean-over-positions is logged on the same batch as an ablation but never backpropagated: a trained mean variant needs a second 30-update trajectory, over the 30 Adam cap
aggregation_ablation.why_worst: one example carries two content starts; the max keeps both routes under pressure and prevents a saturated easy start from cancelling the hard one, which the 19.2f per-world asymmetry (object route 0.469 versus place 0.844) shows is exactly the failure shape

decision.rule: saturation = median top-1 probability >= 0.90 and new-pair hard argmax changes < 18/20

six_cell_repricing.note: measured 19.5 training package is already a realized number, but the owner rule requires functional list x 3.3 before any release; the six-cell rerun stays blocked until owner rules

functional_items.item: 30 Adam selection updates, batch 8, CE + span + margin
two full 192-example passes (free decode + 40 swap pairs each)
two start-score extractions on the 96 new-description examples

budget.rule: budget = functional item list x 3.3; 19.2f reported 100-150 and spent 500.5 is the source

attribution_rules: gamma is the generation weight and 1 - gamma the copy weight
the margin term is a training objective only; the graph is untouched
mechanism_note: 边距项在训练集上恒为零: 64 例抽样 128 个内容起点, m=1.0 下 0 个激活, 最小 gold-decoy 边距 5.313, 中位 8.08 > m。所以本包 30 Adam 实际只训练了 CE (0.0066->0.0007) 与 span, 不是一次边距干预; 训练前后差异应读作再训练噪声, 不得读作边距效应。机制读数分半对齐: 地点起点 top-1 中位 0.999->0.9999, gold-decoy 边距中位 10.42->12.95 (已饱和, 边距已很宽);物件起点 top-1 中位 0.394->0.467, 边距中位 0.695->0.828 (<m, 未饱和)。route_miss 37/96 全在物件侧,故新描述墙不是单一饱和现象: 地点侧是边距吞掉顺序, 物件侧是不确定且选错(描述驱动的判别不足)。

branch_rationale: 判据全不过; route_miss 未降(37->37); 换序硬 argmax 仍 0/20; top-1 中位 0.966>=0.90 -> 按预注册规则落 scoring_head_saturation_is_structural; 但由于边距项在训练集为零梯度, 本判定是该 loss-only 方案无法干预,不是打分头容量不足的直接证伪。结构方案仍是唯一下一步。
